units: <cite ref="Megillah 16b:18">Meg. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>הצָּלַת נפשות</he> saving of human lives.

<cite ref="Gittin 56a:15">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. diction) <he>אפשר דהוי ה׳ פורתא</he> may be some little relief (by royal favor) can be had; <cite ref="Gittin 56b:6">ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>וה׳ פורתא נמי וכ׳</he> and even a little favor will not be shown.
<cite ref="Chullin 52b:17">Ḥull. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>הצלת עצמה</he> the animal’s own effort to save itself; <he>ה׳ אחרים</he> the human efforts to save the animal.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>ה׳ מים</he> saving from drowning; a. fr.
